objects.description: [Salt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1045) has leveraged vulnerabilities in public facing applications and network edge devices including Cisco IOS and IOS XE through CVE-2018-0171, Ivanti Connect Secure through CVE-2023-46805, and Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect through CVE-2024-3400.(Citation: Cisco Salt Typhoon FEB 2025)(Citation: CISA_AA25-239ASaltTyphoon_Sept2025)(Citation: CarySentinelLabs_CiscoSaltTyphoon_Dec2025)
